idea: Signs of a hidden water leak
title: Silent Warning Signs in Your Home's Plumbing
description: Not all plumbing issues present themselves with a dramatic burst pipe. Hidden leaks can slowly cause damage behind walls or under floors before you notice them. Keep an eye out for sudden spikes in your water bill, damp spots on walls or ceilings, unexplained warm areas on hard flooring, or the persistent sound of running water when all faucets are turned off. Musty odors in specific rooms can also point to trapped moisture. Catching these early signs helps protect your home from costly structural damage. If you notice any of these red flags, scheduling a professional leak detection service is the safest next step.
